name: Joe
ref_text: Hope is a quiet thing. It doesn't scream to be heard, but it remains steady when the world gets loud.

source_text: Hope is a quiet thing. It doesn't scream to be heard, but it remains steady when the world gets loud. You have to nurture it, let it grow deep within your soul. In the end, that small spark is what carries us through the longest of nights.
